title.title:
Claude buys the cement.
A person approves it.
title.sub: Nothing scripted: Claude chose every step, and A-CARD answered live.

captions.text: A-CARD connects to Claude Desktop as an MCP server. Nine tools, one agent key.
Claude searches A-MERCHANT for verified suppliers near Germiston.
It makes a single-use card for exactly R57 500, building suppliers only.
Over R25 000, so A-CARD holds it for a person. Claude says so and waits.
Thandi sees the supplier, the amount and the card, and approves.

end.line: Let agents buy. Keep the say.
end.note: Recorded in Claude Desktop against the A-CARD sandbox.
